# Cohort organism evidence

These images render the saved Go frames from `screen/cohorts`, generated by `just docs`. `stacked.png` and `bands.png` export the complete terminal content with the guide's JuliaMono font; `narrow.png` shows the guide's 40-by-16 saved preview. The fixture has three regional cohorts, scalar temperature, summed energy, weighted yield ratios, scalar humidity and a missing temperature observation.

The native fixture was exercised with Tab, Page Down, `b` and `]` to check focus, scrolling, presentation switching and metric changes. Automated organism tests cover one through twelve cohorts, missing-member selection and attention, reference changes, updates, resizing and both presentations. See `pattern/cohort_generic_test.go` for the repeatable interaction assertions.
